candidate_download_source.rights_notes: The repository readme says CrossRefIndex is compiled from R. A. Treat this as a source candidate, not unrestricted public-domain app data, until the share-alike implications are accepted or a purely public-domain source file is chosen.

import_notes: Use scripts/prepare-tsk-metav-cross-references.mjs to convert MetaV Verses.csv and CrossRefIndex.csv into the app's JSON import shape. Then run scripts/import-tsk-cross-references.mjs after rights approval.
